caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent green glass bottle placed centrally on a plain, lightly colored background. The bottle is bulbous at the base, tapering upward to a narrower neck and flaring slightly outward at the rim, which is outlined clearly in a darker green tone. The bottom of the bottle is rounded, and internal reflections and shading give an impression of depth and thickness to the glass. The base is depicted with darker shades, and the overall coloration ranges from deep to light green, with some yellowish highlights. The background is a gradient of beige, darker at the edges and lighter toward the center, leaving the bottle as the focal point with no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Jar
